1.

O God, grant us grace in faith to stand, Despite every foe’s threat, And with Thy joy within the heart to go Toward every suffering!

2.

Grant us a faith that bows itself Silently beneath chastening’s stroke, And rests content, our God, in Thee Within the dark day.

3.

A faith that in the night of distress Shows itself yet stronger, And the bow which Thou hast set in the sky Clearly through the storm sees.

4.

Increase, Lord, thus our faith, The faith that on Thee looks, Which over sin and world prevails In the conflict here.

5.

When faith and hope and prayer are done, Thou, Lord, hast promised to give The crown of righteousness, fair, To the overcomers.
